  • Method Details

    • endpoint

      public NirikshaAI.Builder endpoint(String endpoint)
      Sets the REST base URL of the NirikshaAI instance. Example: https://app.niriksha.ai

    • otlpEndpoint

      public NirikshaAI.Builder otlpEndpoint(String otlpEndpoint)
      Overrides the gRPC ingest address. Example: grpc-ingest.niriksha.ai:443

      When not set, the hostname is parsed from endpoint and combined with otlpPort.

    • apiKey

      public NirikshaAI.Builder apiKey(String apiKey)
      Sets the project API key (nai_...). Sent as the x-api-key gRPC metadata header on every request.

    • serviceName

      public NirikshaAI.Builder serviceName(String serviceName)
      Sets the OpenTelemetry service.name resource attribute. Defaults to java-service.

    • environment

      public NirikshaAI.Builder environment(String environment)
      Sets the OpenTelemetry deployment.environment resource attribute. Defaults to production.

    • otlpPort

      public NirikshaAI.Builder otlpPort(int otlpPort)
      Sets the gRPC port used when deriving the OTLP address from the REST endpoint. Defaults to 4317.

    • insecure

      public NirikshaAI.Builder insecure(boolean insecure)
      When true, exporters use plaintext gRPC (no TLS). Useful for local development or when a TLS-terminating proxy sits in front.

    • tlsSkipVerify

      public NirikshaAI.Builder tlsSkipVerify(boolean tlsSkipVerify)
      When true, TLS certificate validation is skipped. Do not use in production.

    • caCertFile

      public NirikshaAI.Builder caCertFile(String caCertFile)
      Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate file. Use this when your NirikshaAI instance uses a private CA.

    • metricsExportInterval

      public NirikshaAI.Builder metricsExportInterval(Duration metricsExportInterval)
      Sets the metrics export interval. Defaults to 60s.

    • enableMetrics

      public NirikshaAI.Builder enableMetrics(boolean enableMetrics)
      Enables or disables OTLP metric export. Defaults to true.

    • enableLogs

      public NirikshaAI.Builder enableLogs(boolean enableLogs)
      Enables or disables OTLP log export. Defaults to true.

    • sampleRate

      public NirikshaAI.Builder sampleRate(double sampleRate)
      Sets the head-based trace sampling rate (0.0–1.0). Use 0.1 to sample ~10% of traces. Default: 1.0 (sample all).

    • build

      public ShutdownHook build()
      Validates configuration, builds the OpenTelemetry SDK, registers it as the global instance, and returns a ShutdownHook that flushes all pending telemetry on close.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if required fields are missing or configuration is invalid
